brand.name: CRASH LAB
brand.author: Watson Hartsoe
brand.line: Bolas · department of dramaturgical crash testing
brand.about: Experiments in authored motion. Figures keyed by hand in a rig, measured like crash-test dummies, and set into archive film.

programs.title: The Crash-Test Family
programs.line: Three test dummies in a measured bay. Every touch, step and fall is scored for where the weight is, whether the feet hold and whether a hand lands where it was sent.

programs.title: CINEOSIS
programs.line: The crash-test family performs the 45 signs of Deleuze's cinema books, after David Deamer's taxonomy: first in the measured bay, then inside real archive film, then by hand, and finally as a making-of with a blindfolded Critic.

programs.title: The Found Odyssey
programs.tag: one book of the Odyssey per episode
programs.line: Homer's lines are asked by the CALL track and answered by archive speech; a drawn cast acts in graded archive plates. Each episode runs one formal experiment.

programs.title: WYGWYL
programs.tag: Where You Go When You Leave · the cel layer
programs.line: The poet as a jointed paper cut-out made from his own photographs, set over the cineosis-lab cel cuts with the reading on the soundtrack. Every patch is built from the lab's cel database.

characters.name: Bola
characters.spec: yellow · red shoes · a bola on a cord for an antenna
characters.line: The lead dummy. Bola takes the physical, opens the letter, misses the stair and walks into every archive clip in the atlas.

characters.name: Shim
characters.spec: teal · blue shoes · six per cent taller than Bola
characters.line: Bola's partner. Shim holds the door, takes the hug, carries the heavy end and stands beside Bola in the screening room.

characters.name: Dot
characters.spec: coral · black shoes · seventy-two per cent of Bola's size
characters.line: Little Dot. She is lifted, carried and passed between the other two, and she runs under what they have to step over.

characters.name: The extras
characters.line: The crowd of grey dummies who fill the CINEOSIS worlds: queues, parades, audiences, the people Bola walks through.

characters.name: The Critic
characters.line: The fresh reviewer, made a character in Hand Butter. He wears a blindfold because he sees the pictures but not what was meant, and he judges only what is on the screen.

characters.name: Odysseus
characters.line: The man of many turns. Every episode is his, and every costume below is drawn on his body.

characters.name: Odysseus, black-figure
characters.line: The vase-painting style used for title cards and flashbacks: every fill black, every line incised.

characters.name: The crew
characters.line: His companions, who open the bag of winds, eat the cattle and are turned into pigs.

characters.name: Polyphemus
characters.line: The Cyclops of Episodes 1 and 2, who asks the hero's name and is told "Nobody".

characters.name: Zeus
characters.line: Decides by stamping a rubber stamp on the screen where the gods watch Odysseus (Episode 3).

characters.name: Hermes
characters.line: Sent to Calypso's island (Episode 3); flickers like an unsettled projection as he brings the moly (Episode 4).

characters.name: Calypso
characters.line: Keeps Odysseus on her island for seven years and builds the raft that takes him off (Episode 3).

characters.name: Poseidon
characters.line: The god who wrecks the raft (Episode 3).

characters.name: Circe
characters.line: Her cup and wand fail against the moly; on "You are Odysseus" the wand drops from her hand (Episodes 4 and 6).

characters.name: Athena
characters.line: Compiles herself from grey box to ink to colour on the shore of Ithaca (Episode 7).

characters.name: Tiresias
characters.line: The blind seer: he drinks, gets his colour, and warns him off the herds of the Sun (Episode 5).

characters.name: Anticleia
characters.line: His mother. He tries three times to hold her, and each time his arms close through her (Episode 5).

characters.name: Agamemnon
characters.line: The king who never blinks; Odysseus draws his eyelids down for him, and they stay open (Episode 5).

characters.name: Achilles
characters.line: Drinks in a white field, and his colour leaves with him as he strides away (Episode 5).

characters.name: Ajax
characters.line: Stands apart the whole time, never drinks, and goes away in silence (Episode 5).

characters.name: Sisyphus
characters.line: After the credits of Episode 5 his stone gets away from him and rolls back down past him.

characters.name: Odysseus, the old beggar
characters.line: The disguise Athena puts on him, skin, hair, eyes and rags, one part per word (Episode 7).

characters.name: The poet
characters.spec: a jointed paper cut-out from his own photograph · brass pins · paper hands
characters.line: Cut into eleven pieces along his bones and moved by the rig like paper on a table. Replacement heads come from every photograph of him.

characters.name: The replacement heads
characters.spec: six heads, mirrored to twelve turns
characters.line: Front, three-quarter and profile heads, the head bowed in red light, the hand at the glasses and the camera held to the face, chosen frame by frame from the rig's turn and her words.

lab.title: Bolas Pencil Test
lab.line: The three experiments of From Imagetext to Worldtext acted out by ball-and-cord figures, the text beside the action, beat by beat, with a skeletal gate and an X-sheet.

lab.title: Bolas Range Test
lab.line: 54 motions that push one skeleton to the end of every joint's range, scored like a fitness assessment. Video → Bolas turns a clip of any person into the same skeleton and the same report.

lab.title: The Physical
lab.line: Bola reports for a physical: 47 cartoon proofs in six acts, with the joints each proof drives audited underneath.

lab.title: Dramaturgy Crash Lab
lab.line: 132 vignettes for the family in a measured bay, each a small drama and a crash test, then CINEOSIS over 59 more worlds. All-worlds holds the full rig with every world built since, 159 in all.

films.title: Bolas · videotext
films.line: Three experiments from From Imagetext to Worldtext, acted by ball-and-cord figures: a call that builds a doorway, a door that needs somewhere to lead, and a pile of matches sorted into reasons.

films.title: The Physical
films.line: Bola reports for a physical and every test goes wrong in a cartoon way: 47 proofs in six acts that one skeleton can walk, reach, lift, slip, sulk and swoon.

films.title: Crash Lab
films.line: 132 vignettes in a measured bay: letters opened, shoulders touched, doors pushed, stairs missed, and the 32 Acting Arena challenges, each scored for weight, feet, hands and contact.

films.title: CINEOSIS · in the crash lab
films.line: The family performs all 45 signs over 59 measured worlds, each sign its own shot list of cameras, cuts, mirrors and time maps.

films.title: CINEOSIS · hybrid pilot
films.line: Six signs, six real archive clips: the dummies fitted by hand into each plate's camera, light and occlusion, from a lamplit desk to a moving raft.

films.title: CINEOSIS · hybrid atlas
films.line: 84 passages across all 45 signs: an automatic pipeline picks two archive clips per sign, finds the ground, and walks Bola into each one.

films.title: CINEOSIS · handmade
films.line: Every sign authored by hand over unaltered archive clips, two passages per sign, each reviewed blind by a fresh critic.

films.title: CINEOSIS · Hand Butter
films.line: The making-of, performed in a screening room by the film's own cast: Bola and Shim show their work, and a blindfolded Critic judges the pictures without knowing what was meant.

films.title: Handmade · first batch
films.line: The first hand-authored passages, before the first blind review.

films.title: Handmade · signs 1–8
films.line: Review reel of the handmade passages for signs 1 to 8.

films.title: Handmade · signs 13–41
films.line: Review reel of the handmade passages for signs 13 to 41.

films.title: Episode 1 · NOBODY
films.line: Book 9 in three minutes: a prompt box asks for the hero's name, the archive asks for "our young friend's", and Odysseus answers "Nobody."

films.title: Episode 2 · THE GUEST-GIFT
films.line: The Cyclops again, as a flashback at the Phaeacian feast, told by two tellers who remember it differently. The experiment: the recollection-image.

films.title: Episode 3 · THE RAFT
films.line: Book 5 as one story, each act seen from the point of view of whoever is watching it: the gods on their television, Calypso, Poseidon, the sea.

films.title: Episode 4 · CIRCE
films.line: Book 10 re-cut around one line per scene, the place where power shifts: the Laestrygonians, Circe, and the order to sail to the house of Death.

films.title: Episode 5 · THE BLOOD
films.line: Book 11 in grey, where the only colour is the blood in the trench and whichever shade has drunk it.

films.title: Episode 6 · THE KNOT
films.line: Book 12, built on hands that hold things: the mast, the cord, the oar. A held object is drawn inside the grip: palm, object, fingers, thumb.

films.title: Episode 7 · THE LOOP
films.line: Book 13 as a loop: seven agents try to land the sleeping man on Ithaca and fail, until a grip holds, Athena compiles, and the old beggar is put together part by part.

films.title: Drawn tests · NOBODY, THE SIRENS, ARGOS
films.line: The first three drawn shots: figures in archive plates, Homer asked by the CALL track and answered by archive speech.

films.title: Style lab
films.line: Six ways for the drawing to meet the footage, from clean ink to matched film stock, played over the same two beats.

films.title: Drawn tests · second pass
films.line: The chosen style applied to the three test shots.

films.title: Episode 2 · draft opening
films.line: First cut of Episode 2's cold open and title.

films.title: Poem 07
films.line: Poem 07, all twelve patches, made by the automatic pipeline: gestures cued by the words, heads chosen by the rig, plates made from his photographs.

films.title: The paper poet · first proof
films.line: The poet as a jointed paper cut-out from his own photograph, over his Mexico City plates, with each patch's archive cel framed on a cardboard plinth.

films.title: Cel-cut style proof
films.line: Two looks over the lab's cel cuts: a faceless figure under one hard light, and 1930s rubber hose on watercolour.

films.title: Ink cel · P05-008
films.line: The first ink cel for WYGWYL: "Their blood flows through my hands."
